findings.title: Complaint opens into tracking and hope
findings.claim: Within the pericope, disclosed grief and retained knowledge become a directed search whose movement, sensory tracking, relief, and prohibition of despair keep the possibility of recovery open.
findings.mechanism: The complaint and knowledge carriers at 12:86 contact the focus imperatives to go and investigate, while the two relief and despair occurrences bind that movement to a divine source of renewed capacity; the covering branch marks the contrary closure.
findings.reader_payoff: Hope is newly perceptible as direction-preserving inquiry and room to act, rather than as a demand to deny grief.
findings.containment: The literal search for Yusuf and his brother and the literal prohibition of despair remain intact. This finding does not decide the hidden facts, replace relief with wind or rest, or assert a whole-surah system beyond the supplied pericope.

epistemic.reason: The channel support is trusted, citable, and supplies exact native context and focus contacts for every retained branch.

findings.containment: The literal accusation is not adjudicated, and the HFT branch mappings remain attributed because the packet supplies surface Arabic but no target morphology. The finding does not claim that every description is false.

findings.mechanism: The 12:80 carriers mark cutoff, private contraction, counsel, and non-departure; the focus carriers place the same despair root between an imperative to go and the divine relief phrase, making the object and bodily direction of despair materially different.
findings.reader_payoff: The prohibition becomes a change in where expectation is placed and what the body does with it, not a demand to pretend the earlier impasse did not happen.
findings.containment: The sequence supports a reversal without proving a single causal mechanism. The literal despair and literal departure remain primary, and the HFT inference that motion follows the changed object stays qualified.

epistemic.reason: The exact 12:80 and 12:87 surface anchors are supplied, while branch roles and the causal link remain attributed HFT interpretation.

findings.title: Relief takes distributive form

findings.containment: The literal request for measure and charity remains primary. The HFT inference does not establish that the transaction itself exhausts the meaning of rawh or that material restoration is the only form of relief.

epistemic.reason: The exact 12:88 Arabic and all trace coordinates are supplied, but the branch identities for the contextual roots are attributed HFT evidence.

findings.title: Two directions of covering
findings.claim: The focus's truth-covering posture is set beside the later sequence of recognition, acknowledged error, blame removed, forgiveness, and mercy, so covering can close a damaged relation or protect it while reopening it.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 12:87 contacts attributed carriers for ignorance, error, withheld blame, protective forgiveness, and mercy at 12:89-92; the common covering relation changes direction according to what it conceals and what it protects.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing class is no longer only a fixed label: the pericope makes visible an opposed moral operation in which a cover can either block truth or shelter repair.
findings.containment: The focus's ordinary classification remains intact, and the opposed-covering relation is an attributed contextual resonance. It does not equate divine forgiveness with concealment of truth or erase the brothers' acknowledged error.

epistemic.reason: The exact pericope sequence is supplied, while the cross-root covering analogy and contextual branch identities remain HFT-qualified.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence removes the mechanism of reproach from the damaged relation.

branch_activations.boundary: The context record does not independently define this branch beyond its attributed role.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: A relation can move from hidden wrongdoing toward recognized wrongdoing without being sealed by it.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains attributed and does not supply a full account of moral responsibility.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence carries protective covering of fault.

findings.title: Kinship becomes a sensory relay
findings.claim: Across 12:84, 12:87, and 12:93, the family functions as a distributed sensory relay: impaired sight is met by delegated investigation, a material trace returns, vision is restored, and dispersed members are gathered.
findings.mechanism: The damaged eye, focus search and departure, transported garment, directed placement, restored seeing, and gathering form a closed sequence in which kin extend perception outward and bring it back to the injured site.
findings.reader_payoff: The command to search gains a concrete bodily and familial payoff: the movement of the sons carries the father's impaired perception toward repair.
findings.containment: The literal family search and later garment scene remain primary. The HFT inference may be a structured relay or merely a logistical sequence; no branch is claimed beyond the supplied attributed contacts.

epistemic.reason: The exact three-ayah surface anchors and focus returns are complete, but most contextual branch identities are unresolved HFT evidence.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence carries restored seeing at the end of the relay.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier damaged eye and focus sensory search supply the relay's starting and middle points.
branch_activations.activation: Restored sight gives the outward search a concrete perceptual return.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The family search can culminate in repaired seeing.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied for this context record.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Kinship can be perceived as a structure whose members extend and restore one another.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus noun remains an address to sons; the building image is a qualified resonance.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence gathers dispersed family members.

branch_activations.activation: Gathering gives the distributed sensory relay a social completion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Perceptual repair and family reassembly arrive as one closing movement.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is an attributed contextual role, not an independent claim that all gathering is sensory.

branch_activations.activation: The search verb becomes the delegated sensory function between the two states of sight.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sons carry perception outward for the father and return with a sign that restores it.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek hareket, bir şeyin bulunduğu yerden gidip ilerlemesi veya geçmesidir.

branch_activations.activation: Repeated going changes from one-way search into a relay with a return path.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Movement is the carrier by which perception and material evidence circulate through the family.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not claim that every repeated departure has symbolic relay structure.

findings.title: A social eye without operative sight
findings.claim: The focus can be pictured, exploratorily and without essentializing its named group, as an intact social apparatus whose perception is covered: the search then rehearses reactivation through restored sight.
findings.mechanism: The supplied qawm branch specifies visible eye structure with lost sight, the focus kfr carrier supplies covering, the hss verb supplies active perception, and 12:84 and 12:93 supply bodily loss and reversible restoration.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing class becomes a diagnostic image of blocked perception rather than a flat label, while the later restored sight keeps the image open to change.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory analogy with a form-distant qawm branch. The ordinary focus wording remains intact; the analogy is not an essential claim about a people, and it must not be extended beyond the supplied eye, covering, search, and restored-sight contacts.

epistemic.reason: The HFT packet explicitly marks this outlier exploratory and form-distant, while providing exact focus and pericope anchors for a bounded analogy.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence supplies restored seeing as the analogy's reversible endpoint.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names a collective whose perception is described through covering and search.
branch_activations.activation: Restored sight prevents the social-eye image from becoming an essential identity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Blocked perception remains capable of reactivation within the supplied sequence.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied for this context record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dış dünyadaki bir şeyi bir duyu aracılığıyla algılama.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus search carries active sensory perception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named collective and covering phrase supply the social capacity whose perception is at issue.
branch_activations.activation: Active sensing provides the opposed operation to a covered social eye.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The search rehearses the reactivation of perception rather than merely describing movement.
branch_activations.boundary: The analogy does not turn the focus search into a metaphor only.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed context occurrence gives the bodily eye-loss analogue.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus qawm branch supplies the collective carrier for the diagnostic extension.
branch_activations.activation: Jacob's damaged eye supplies an embodied precedent for perception present in structure but absent in operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The social-eye analogy is anchored in a reversible bodily image.
branch_activations.boundary: The context eye is not claimed to be lexically identical with the qawm branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme yetisi kaybolur, fakat göz bebeği ve gözün görünür yapısı sağlam kalır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus qawm occurrence carries the supplied intact-eye-without-sight branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjacent covering participle and active sensory imperative provide the independent directional contrast.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The named group can be read diagnostically as socially intact but unable to perceive the available relief.
branch_activations.boundary: This is only an exploratory analogy, not an essential description of the group or a general theory of unbelief.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus covering branch supplies the blocking operation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The qawm eye-without-sight image and the search verb supply the capacity and its possible reactivation.
branch_activations.activation: Covering is the mechanism that leaves the apparatus intact while preventing operative sight.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Despair is pictured as covered perception rather than mere absence of an eye.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary covering and disbelief readings remain primary; this is a bounded analogy.

friction_notes: The HFT packet supplies exact Arabic surface anchors but no target morphology; unresolved contextual branches are therefore retained only as attributed evidence with null gloss and facet fields.

The exploratory social-eye finding is form-distant and is bounded to the supplied qawm, covering, search, impaired-eye, and restored-sight contacts; it must not be generalized into an essential classification.

The explicitly added Fatiha ayat were quarantined during the native/pericope pass and reviewed as an overlay afterward. No external ayah supplied a distinct branch-level delta with a valid focus return beyond the native/pericope findings, so no external overlay finding is emitted.
